summary.text: Matthew Brown is the Democratic candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Hillsborough 12, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Brown described himself as a resident of Merrimack and a former student representative on the Merrimack School Board.

paragraphs.text: Matthew Brown attended Merrimack High School.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he formerly served as student representative on the Merrimack School Board and the Merrimack Parks & Recreation Committee, and that he is the namesake of House Bill 1109, the Matthew Brown Act, which added an eating disorders helpline to student ID cards in 2024.
Brown listed his campaign messages as affordability, including lower taxes on senior citizens and working families, well-funded public schools, and bipartisanship.
He named education, small business and mental health as the policy areas he is most passionate about.
